Episode Notes:
Patrick continues his conversation with two veterans of the Air Force's 53rd Weather Reconnaissance Squadron, better known as the Hurricane Hunters. In the second of two parts, they take listeners inside the storm itself, walking through what happens on the flight deck and at the weather station as the crew closes in on the eye. They also look back on the flights they still talk about years later, and on the trust that holds a crew together when the weather turns against them.
